items.statement: The independent calculation supports the conclusion that neutral tetra(triflate) compound 2 has a dominant near-UV singlet excitation chiefly associated with the N6-centred HOMO-4 to LUMO configuration, consistent with stabilization of occupied N6-related orbitals by electron-withdrawing triflate substituents, subject to method and coverage limitations.
items.expected: A final claim connects the validated compound-2 dominant excitation and oscillator strength with HOMO-4 to LUMO/N6 character, explains the triflate-substituent interpretation, and states limitations.
